title: MARS-X Dataset Metadata
description: Schema for validating NASA/ESA Mars dataset metadata entries used in the MARS-X platform.

dataset_id.description: Unique lowercase identifier for this dataset (letters, digits, hyphens, underscores only).

mission.description: Space mission that produced the data (e.g. Mars Global Surveyor, Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter).

instrument.description: Instrument or camera that acquired the data.

product_type.description: Type of data product (e.g. DTM, image, spectral cube, geologic map).

spatial_resolution.description: Ground sampling distance or spatial resolution (e.g. '463 m/px'). Null for non-spatial datasets.

acquisition_date_range.description: Temporal coverage of the dataset (e.g. '1999-2001'). Null if not applicable.

geographic_footprint.description: Spatial extent description (e.g. 'Global', 'Gale Crater'). Null if not defined.

source_url.description: Primary URL for accessing or learning about this dataset.

data_format.description: File format of the data product (e.g. GeoTIFF, PDS IMG, JPEG, CSV).

coverage.description: Description of spatial/temporal coverage. Null if not specified.

processing_status.description: Current state of this dataset in the MARS-X pipeline.

scientific_limitations.description: Known limitations or caveats for scientific use. Null if none documented.

description.description: Full description of the dataset and its scientific purpose.
